lines.speaker: narrator
lines.line: Cold drizzle turns Thornwick's market square into churned ochre paste as watch-bells clang from the river gate.

lines.speaker: npc-garrick-captain
lines.line: Three patrols overdue from Sunken Ford, and now smoke's rising off the tollhouse roof.

lines.speaker: npc-hobb-smith
lines.line: The capital sent ceremonial plumes instead of arrowheads, Garrick. Half my pikes are bent plowshares.

lines.speaker: npc-marta-alchemist
lines.line: Keep your men out of the black reeds if they take a scratch—gnoll iron is greased with fen-rot.

lines.speaker: npc-fenwick-ferryman
lines.line: River's running red past my eel-weirs. Somebody paid good silver to put warbands on the north road.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.line: Count the dry bowstrings and muster whoever can still march. We take the ford before noon.

lines.speaker: npc-garrick-captain
lines.line: You heard the commander. Check your cinch-straps—nobody gets buried on company time.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.line: Iron-shod boots splash through the southern postern as crows lift lazily from the palisade stakes.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.line: Ashbrook's splintered gatehouse smolders against a bruised twilight as handcarts creak south toward the boundary obelisk.

lines.speaker: npc-garrick-captain
lines.line: Vaelen's banners are broken, though half the town is packed onto three wagons with nothing but seed-corn.

lines.speaker: npc-marta-alchemist
lines.line: Morvessa's hex-writs were stamped at the Border Mint. This wasn't a border raid—it was a foreclosure.

lines.speaker: npc-hobb-smith
lines.line: Pack extra rivets and lamp oil. Redmarsh alkali eats honest iron faster than a rust-mite.

lines.speaker: npc-fenwick-ferryman
lines.line: My punt stops at the boundary stone. Beyond here, all the rivers died five hundred years ago.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.line: Burn what we cannot haul and double the outriders. Morvessa went south, and we follow.

lines.speaker: npc-garrick-captain
lines.line: Forward march. Keep your canteens covered and your shields high.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.line: Behind the column, Thornwick's distant watchtowers gutter out in the drizzle as red dust rises ahead.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.line: Heat shimmers off rust-red salt pans where Redmarsh Outpost leans crookedly on oak pilings.

lines.speaker: npc-bram-quartermaster
lines.line: Welcome to the bottom of a dead sea. Water is four silver a gill, and shade costs extra.

lines.speaker: npc-tull-water-seller
lines.line: Do not drink from unsealed troughs—desert clans poison the wells with scorpion-bile before retreating.

lines.speaker: npc-zahra-scholar
lines.line: Someone is cracking the plateau wardstones to the east. If those quartz spires rupture, the alkali swallows the passes.

lines.speaker: field-warden-hale
lines.line: Sand-raiders hold the Twin Passes with horn-bows, and my vanguard scouts are pinned in Bracken Basin.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.line: Open the causeway first, pull Hale's scouts out of the scrub, and secure the wardstones.

lines.speaker: npc-bram-quartermaster
lines.line: Bring back any intact brass valves you find—my mules are hauling empty barrels.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.line: A dry copper wind rattles bleached ribs along the causeway as the vanguard steps onto the salt crust.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.line: Rusted sluice-wheels shriek open atop Ironheart Bastion, revealing empty silt beds below and grey surf beyond.

lines.speaker: npc-bram-quartermaster
lines.line: Forty years guarding dry cisterns. Gorrathul starved a province to protect an empty bucket.

lines.speaker: npc-zahra-scholar
lines.line: His last words confirmed it: Morvessa's sea-galleys are already massing along the Iron Coast.

lines.speaker: npc-tull-water-seller
lines.line: Drink a pint of coastal rainwater for me when you reach Oakhaven. I've forgotten how water tastes without chalk.

lines.speaker: field-miner-tomas
lines.line: The Deep Quarry is flooded and our chains are broken. My lads will march with you down to the sea.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.line: Raise our banner on the high parapet so the rear guard sees the pass is clear. We descend at dawn.

lines.speaker: field-warden-hale
lines.line: Watch the switchbacks—salt gales peel careless men straight off the scree.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.line: Far below the forked peak, black smoke curls upward from Harborwatch's distant bay.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.line: Freshly split pine sap and cold salt spray sweep Oakhaven's cliffs as shipwright axes echo ceaselessly through the ironwood groves.

lines.speaker: npc-aldric-bailiff
lines.line: Ironheart's cisterns were dry silt, and now tens of thousands pour down from the wastes. Every hull has a waterline, commander—not everyone on the pier will ever board.

lines.speaker: npc-kors-shipwright
lines.line: Miner Gorin and his freed quarry smiths are already hammering black-ironstone plates onto our caravels, yet raider packs choke the northern frontier pass.

lines.speaker: npc-elowen-scholar
lines.line: Chronicler Zahra sent me her quartz wardstone notes from Redmarsh. Unless we break the corrupted cinder-wards on the cliffs, the bedrock itself will shear into the sea.

lines.speaker: npc-sera-healer
lines.line: Familiar faces from Thornwick—Reeve Marlow and Father Cael among them—are limping into my canvas tents. Keep the road open while I bind their wounds.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.line: Re-arm at Toren's forge and hold the frontier pass. We are the Shield of the Departing—every minute we buy in blood floats another keel.

lines.speaker: npc-aldric-bailiff
lines.line: Bailiff's gate is open. Relieve Captain Bram at the Northern Post before his banner falls.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.line: Distant tectonic tremors shake pine needles onto the mud-churned staging ground as the vanguard marches north.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.line: The choking pitch-smoke over Harborwatch thins beneath a freezing western gale as the last caravel clears the shattered breakwater.

lines.speaker: npc-veyra-marshal
lines.line: Lord-Captain Korvus lies in the black surf, and the evacuation armada is past the horizon. Look out there—their dawn is on the water.

lines.speaker: npc-kors-shipwright
lines.line: The slipways are utterly empty. Only severed mooring ropes sway in the black tide, yet every child and seed-cask sailed untouched.

lines.speaker: npc-orson-quartermaster
lines.line: All surviving histories and seed-grain vaults made the hulls. What remains on this stone quay are weapons, ash, and those who refused a berth.

lines.speaker: npc-aldric-bailiff
lines.line: Fifty leagues east, the sky has torn open into incandescent violet. As long as the Iron Pact's ritual burns in the Caldera, this coast will never cool.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.line: Turn your backs to the ocean. We bought them their morning—now we march east into the night.

lines.speaker: npc-veyra-marshal
lines.line: My Harborwatch veterans march beside you. Let us finish what began at Thornwick.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.line: From the ash-choked sky, a tiny column of steel turns away from the empty harbor and marches straight along the cracked obsidian road toward the volcano.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.line: Freezing alpine wind lashes Highcrest Citadel's granite spires, colliding with gray volcanic ash rising from the Obsidian Caldera.

lines.speaker: npc-vance-marshal
lines.line: The evacuation fleet is beyond the Western Rim. Fear has nothing left to hold over us—we are here to settle this war cleanly.

lines.speaker: npc-veyra-marshal
lines.line: My Harborwatch rearguard didn't stay behind to watch from a parapet, Vance. Point us at the Iron Pact's outer passes.

lines.speaker: npc-elda-smith
lines.line: Ordinary steel melts like tallow in the caldera vents. Take Tier 5 meteoric ironplate and armor-sundering halberds before you climb.

lines.speaker: npc-orla-archivist
lines.line: That brass seal on your hand—Morvessa's Signet Ring—is the missing key. Her Salt Tithe was meant to reinforce the Order Seals before the Iron Pact hijacked the treasury.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.line: Sweep the forward scouts, shatter the runic beacons with Zahra's calculations, and break the Infernal Citadel's gates.

lines.speaker: npc-vance-marshal
lines.line: No civilians left to shield, only steel and will. Forward march into Ashveil Gorge.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.line: Blue wardstones hum above the citadel parapet as the united rearguard steps onto the ash-draped highland pass.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.line: Deep beneath the sundered Infernal Sanctuary, the deafening roar of the Obsidian Caldera settles into an ancient, resonant stillness.

lines.speaker: npc-orla-archivist
lines.line: From Morvessa's ledgers to Gorrathul's dry mountain and Harborwatch's burning piers, the final entry in the Threshold Chamber is written.

lines.speaker: npc-veyra-marshal
lines.line: Every ship that sailed west will hear what happened here—whether they return to a quiet shore or kneel before an iron throne.

lines.speaker: npc-vance-marshal
lines.line: The Iron Pact is dust. The rearguard has fulfilled its oath to the last blade.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.line: Send word along the basalt highway from Highcrest to the Border Fords. The reckoning of Thornvael is finished.

lines.speaker: npc-orla-archivist
lines.line: May whatever dawn follows remember the price paid in salt, stone, and ash.

lines.speaker: npc-vance-marshal
lines.line: Sound the recall horns across the ridge. Lower the shields.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.line: Across four scarred provinces, the long night of Thornvael turns toward its new age.
